_comment: Copy to config.json (or point ARTEX_CONFIG at another path). This file holds only database and skill_dir; other config such as the LLM goes through environment variables or in-app settings, not this file.
_comment_database: PostgreSQL connection. Priority: the ARTEX_PG_DSN environment variable > database in this file. Two ways, choose one: (A) fill in the separate fields below; (B) fill only database.dsn with one full connection string.
_comment_database_dsn: Form (B): delete database above and use a full DSN instead. When dsn is non-empty the separate fields are ignored.
_comment_skill_dir: The skill root directory (one skill per sub-directory, each with SKILL.md). Priority: the ARTEX_SKILL_DIR environment variable > this field > the default (skills/ next to the executable). Leave it blank or remove this field to use the default. A relative path is resolved against the current working directory.
